blocks.text: Thanks for the background. We are into the coverage now. Kimberly Le has pulled the last eighteen months of press and analyst notes on {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}}, and we are sorting it by theme so we have a clear picture before we speak to anyone. Nothing in it has surprised us so far, which is worth knowing in its own right.

A couple of things from your side would move us along: the names of the people you would want us to hear from for the perception read, inside the company and out, and any investor messaging you have used in the past year, even rough drafts, so we can see the Gallegos, Pope and Marsh voice as it stands today.
I will send the perception-scan questions to you, Robert Smith, by the end of the week, and a short call to walk through them works just as well if that is easier.
